data_fields.name: addon_flood_count
data_fields.donor_constant: 100 (declared; unreachable from HandleMessagechatOpcode, see note section 6)

best_idea: Count every chat attempt in a sliding window, arm a timed mute on the Nth attempt in a run, and check the mute after counting, so a burst mutes the burster and never a slow talker.
decision_why: Take the count-then-arm flood gate and its three data fields, but store the mute per character as a wall-clock expiry (the donor stores it per account) and run the same gate on addon-language and every other player-sent type (the donor skips both).
acceptance: A server test sends 10 chat lines 0.5 s apart; the 10th is refused with a wait notice showing the remaining seconds; a line sent 11 s after the trip is accepted; 10 lines sent 1.5 s apart never trip the gate.
